高朋滿座#162粵
programme.desc: 慶召開緊急會議，因高家獲政府封為模範家庭，特首要來家訪。慶組織了「接特委員會」，計劃多采多姿的節目，讓特首留下深刻印象。可是當根聽到內容後，力斥眾人的計劃毫無新意，更力薦自己擔任搞手，慶聽後意動答應。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#7粵普
programme.desc: 洪七公不辭而別後，歐陽克擄走黃蓉，郭靖通過記號找到並救下黃蓉。二人泛舟湖上，偶遇陸乘風並受邀到歸雲莊作客。黃蓉發現莊園為奇門遁甲的佈局，好奇下夜裡拉著郭靖出門，卻發現太湖集結了一眾以陸冠英為首的湖盜…

programme.title: 食平3D粵
programme.desc: 骨少肉嫩的彩虹鯛煮法多變，肥媽教煲「彩虹鯛越式酸湯」。「油炸鬼」煮餸相當好吃，一道「鬼馬龍鳳球」封住了六號嘴巴。菜價上升，學肥媽用水果炒菜，「青紅蘋果煙肉炒雞柳」只需25元。還有壓軸的「乳香肥牛卷」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 夏日炎炎，中暑不單與高溫有關，個人體質也是關鍵因素，其中四類人士較易中暑？中醫師帶來有助舒緩輕微中暑的穴位按壓法，並推介消暑湯水。人際關係中，「依附風格」反映人們處於壓力與脆弱狀態時，尋求安全感的心理模式。臨床心理學家指出，依附風格可分為安全型、焦慮型、逃避型及恐懼逃避型，並細說面對婚姻恐懼的不同表現。理解彼此的依附需要是維持關係的要點，相處上有何建議？「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨示範「西洋菜海鮮燴飯」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 日式廚師發辦不需三百元人民幣？深圳親民套餐包海膽甜筒、和牛壽喜燒、鵝肝雪花配吞拿魚，CP值高！吃飽後要「滑」走脂肪，秀怡約同慧儀玩室內衝浪，惟兩位新手未玩已被澎湃衝浪聲嚇親，秀怡更遭拍檔水花攻擊？美女們為補充骨膠原轉赴珠海覓食，花膠撈飯、燜乾鮑和海參一次滿足美顏、吃貨願望。香港酒樓有抵食燒味推介，燒鵝、乳豬、白切雞統統只售一蚊？百年蛇羹老字號承傳家族秘方，同時以精緻蛇羹、糯米飯下午茶一新大家耳目！

programme.title: 東坡家事#23粵PG
programme.desc: 皇上欲讓琴操獻齋討好太后，東坡建議由閏之代煮；東坡不明閏之為何不讓琴操見太后，閏之稱琴操喜歡東坡。子才指賈大嬸和東坡父親蘇洵有私情，東坡從琴操送的蘇洵字畫中推算他還有四弟；東坡和閏之找賈大嬸查問……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 班上舉行遊樂會，小丸子抽中與丸尾、永澤、藤木和笹山一組，她們決定與同學們玩「猜猜我是誰」問答遊戲。小丸子不慎打翻果汁弄髒姐姐的秀樹剪報，姐姐生日將至，小丸子決定織手繩送她作禮物。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 運動好處多，這次「WORKOUT 2GETHER」先做伸展練習，坐上瑜伽墊，試試逐步向下壓拉筋及轉體伸展。然後來一個「弓箭步壓腿」，保持十五秒；再將手放肩上「畫圓圈」，放鬆一下膊頭。運動除了讓身體動起來，還可改善一些不良姿勢，包括圓肩、寒背、高低膊等。伸出兩隻拇指放下巴，帶動頭移向上；舉起手臂，幻想是一道門並來回開合；雙手互扣，讓整個人向上伸展。常低頭玩手機的朋友不妨多加練習，對舒緩肩頸有幫助。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 經過一番心理掙扎，小源三人終於重新振作，再度與史納樂隊對峙。然而，儘管公主卯足全力，仍然無法填補雙方的實力差距，處於下風。正當她們感到一籌莫展，小奈的歌聲竟傳到來耳邊……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5��50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 過去本港實行九年免費教育，固然有不少好處，不過有一批學生不喜歡讀書，但又要被迫上學，學校也很難處理。他們的成績很多由小學已經追不上，而且在學校經常鬧事，但是不讓他們上學，後果可能更加嚴重。新聞掏寶和大家重溫1995年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#4粵
programme.desc: 唐芯喜愛的男團主音楊帆曾紅極一時，卻突然星途隕落，原與萬里有關。跨世代公關公司老闆高冠一欲入股某AI公司，要求萬里設法討好該公司的CEO，此人卻與萬里有過節。該公司將推出內置基圍蝦AI的智能手機，萬里需構思宣傳計劃，CEO要求萬里試用手機三天並完成AI訓練模型。萬里與唐芯、嘉冰嘗試合力「養大」基圍蝦AI，卻生變故……CEO再設法為難萬里，更非禮其下屬曾碧池。萬里忍無可忍，要求冠一終止合作計劃……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#9粵PG
programme.desc: 飯局上曉彤深得苓君歡心，家謙卻心不在焉。曉彤一直與弟弟胡哲朗競爭，她乘機自薦接手東馹新汽車項目，由家謙負責新廣告。曉彤看出家謙心事，提醒他於婚前做好抉擇。熙妍猜到幸如就是家謙的意中人，替家謙身不由己感可惜。幸如偶遇低血糖頭暈的曉彤，及時幫了她，彼此留下印象。繼威相約幸如為母親李佩貞慶生，雪文令幸如失約，並設法討好佩貞，但原來一切都在幸如計劃之內；她知道雪文憧憬組織家庭，遂故意向雪文透露佩貞喜好……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 油漆工人常接觸揮發性化學物，是患鼻咽癌主因嗎？化學病理學系教授指自小吃鹹魚「禍害」更深！鼻咽位於鼻腔深處，常於晚期才見病徵，而發病年齡較其他癌症普遍較低？鼻咽癌又名廣東瘤，原來99%港人體內有一種EB病毒，正是元兇。做檢測有陽性反應未必患癌，如何測試才會更精準？鼻咽癌較難用切除方式治療，做放射治療更有效，調查員秀怡外出向技師請教相關的「強度調控」新技術。另有中醫醫院教授細說治療癌症病人的主要方向。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#14粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語照顧發燒的紀封，最後順利把鹹肉帶回酒店；紀封想給蜜語補償，蜜語選擇做員工職業方向評估；中菜廳重開，翹琪發現鹹肉被掉包，幸好早有對策化解，令翱翔的計劃失敗；第二天中菜廳生意火爆，薛睿和蜜語協助調度。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
再創世紀#22粵
programme.desc: 定垚怪責啟堂，沒有告知做換心手術。海泉隱瞞患肺癌又不就醫，明晞氣惱。啟堂返回傲堂，對公司的轉變均感礙眼，尤其忌憚高哲。天生看出啟堂仍充滿野心，決定利用。澤雨的眾籌平台出事，程凱擔心。澤雨在董事會內受壓，心灰意冷，主動到內地分公司幫忙；當看到分公司情景，有點氣餒。定垚接受訪問，依寧故意吹捧她為綠色企業家，惹啟堂妒忌。啟堂查出高哲是克網的話事人，將高哲牽頭的大嶼山項目叫停。定垚找高哲求證，高哲卻失蹤。

programme.title: 東坡家事#24粵PG

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 好拍檔江美儀、麥長青（麥包）暫別街市、屋邨地頭，一起來到Do姐主場遊樂一番！韓國一款表面雪白、平平無奇的粥品，售價竟跟鮑魚粥看齊，內有甚麼乾坤？日本一間居酒屋養了多頭猴子駐場，除了充當「侍應」之外，牠們還懂得表演娛賓？各地流傳不同祈福習俗，台灣屏東東隆宮亦有一種特別的轉運方法！根據過往經驗，旅遊熱點的貨幣均匯率較高，美儀、麥包可會遵循這個方向揀選「心水」地方？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 吳若希、譚嘉儀、鄭俊弘、林穎彤四位「星夢」歌手分成兩隊，接受Do姐出題考驗。胡慧冲帶大家參觀的泰國豪宅，並非給人居住，而是供燕子棲息，但要吸引燕子入屋築巢原來有竅妙。陸永一看貼士便想出答案，還暗諷Do姐見識少！兩隊接着享用大廚炮製的竹燕窩，並要答出這矜貴食材如何形成。鄺潔楹慕名到訪東京得獎食店，內裡食品美味，環境殘舊，究竟獲得甚麼獎項？兌換貨幣環節，兩隊面對四個陌生地方，是否選「島」有着數？

高朋滿座#163粵
programme.desc: 不懂下廚的富太朱莉亞，將整個菜檔包下來揀菜。朋好心教授揀菜心得，但富太毫不在意。朋回到廚藝中心，發現該名富太竟是他班上的學生。朋更發現，朱莉亞對廚藝雖極有熱誠，但卻亳無天分，更弄出不少笑話，令朋燒傷。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 楊康被擒關在歸雲莊，他本想騙穆念慈替金人通風報信卻被識破。穆念慈給梅超風留下求救消息後被歐陽克挾持，歐陽克逼梅超風交出《九陰真經》。陸乘風收到骷髏頭，知道歸雲莊有難，此時裘千仞和六怪也來到莊內。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 樓盤新視野 之港島東太古式生活粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 今集「大茶飯」請來星級大廚余健志、陳國強、伍嘉琦、楊國基、陳彥琳作客。肥媽以「紅蝦印度黃飯」作下馬威，再以榴槤殼、榴槤核做出令他們拍案叫絕的美食？還有「日式芥末豬頸肉」、「鹹魚煎肉餅」、「炸皮蛋」。

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 深圳的購物公園站一帶，可謂吃貨天堂，「女神們」一試無醃過的烤鴨，品嚐原汁原味，配小麥餅皮、蒜泥、海鹽，各有滋味。轉往坪洲站走進俄羅斯貨品集中的超市，主持為你試「伏」，百分百沙棘汁似乎太酸，加椴樹蜜可「解救」？珠海的一家煲仔飯店，食煲仔飯都可玩盲盒？幸運的話，人民幣35元就能吃到鮑魚蝦煲仔飯！在香港的歷史建築中覓食，享用美饌同時感受歷史文化。這集為大家搜羅到浪漫二人餐與摩登潮州菜四人餐着數。

programme.title: 東坡家事#24粵PG
programme.desc: 東坡和閏之懷疑皇上胎記，從太后入手調查。皇帝聽到民間歌謠指他篡位而大怒……賈大嬸請太后打聽身上有三星的孩子，太后聽後感疑惑。岐王準備宣布皇上非正統，安石出現解圍。嘉王和岐王始終不信，皇上指上天可證……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子佩服長山博覽群書，但長山表示有人比他看更多書，就是只在圖書卡上見過名字的篠原由香里。小丸子因為音樂課的緣故而想看朦朧月，卻一直守候不果，此時爺爺提出兩人應該要迷迷糊糊地等。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 玲玲姐姐分享看到海盜電影戲裡的神秘寶箱，都想擁有一個；「Artspiration」環節，子健哥哥教她親自動手繪畫。只需透過紙與筆，就可畫出專屬的夢幻寶箱，同時隨意填滿珍珠、金條等豐富珠寶！羅皓誼(Chloe姐姐)再次亮相節目，並帶來跟爸爸的合照，「開心SHARE」我和家人最相似的地方。Tiffany姐姐、Emily姐姐細談童年時和弟弟到遊樂園玩耍的回憶，令Chloe姐姐這位獨生女羨慕不已。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 史納樂隊的頭目，也就是侵襲愛麗絲比亞的黑幕，赤之女王終於在公主面前現身。赤之女王主張，為了讓愛麗絲比亞得以存續，這裡的人必須變得更強。而她的一連串行為，實情都是促使進化的試煉。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 樓盤新視野 之港島東太古式生活粵
programme.desc: 紅磡一個2,000多平方呎單位，由六房改四房，業主還希望增設酒吧區，如何減低對家人影響？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#5粵
programme.desc: 萬里與冠一關係鬧僵，堵氣休假。她原本安排高級客戶經理朱圓圓跟進某位大客戶的廣告事宜，惟客戶只信任萬里，全因她當年負責的廣告極受歡迎，客戶要求舊版廣告主角楊帆參與宣傳。當年楊帆卻因該廣告淪為笑柄，仿如人間蒸發，圓圓向萬里求助。萬里視此大客為抗衡冠一的籌碼，幸得唐芯幫忙聯絡上楊帆。楊帆設法報復，多番整蠱萬里，萬里唯有忍辱負重……冠一安排萬里銷假復工，正當眾人以為他已讓步，怎料冠一竟有意想不到的安排……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#10粵PG
programme.desc: 汽車廣告簽約前夕，怎料啟榮卻在背後搞破壞……曉彤計劃邀巨星拍廣告不果，面對父親胡振東施壓，感無計可施。發佈會最終大成功，曉彤感謝家謙，家謙心知是藉幸如的預知夢立功。繼威中了幸如的圈套，欠下更多債務。繼威向佩貞借錢不果，卻得知若自己結婚生子，佩貞便會給他買房子的錢。另邊廂，幸如拜託家謙扮作跟她偷情，逼繼威主動分手……幸如要在佩貞面前假扮與家謙親熱，令佩貞逼繼威與她分手，怎料幸如與家謙卻意外親吻了。

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 為了全面剖析案例患者椎間盤突出的病因，調查科邀來博士和醫生，以中西協作方式聯合會診。斜身歪坐、年老退化、缺乏運動都可能是患病成因，博士亦提醒不正確使用按摩槍或會誘發其他痛症，而不良推拿手法則可加重病情。調查團隊引領觀眾走進中醫醫院，參觀前線的復康科技。譚俊彥親試怎樣藉機械輔助重新學走路；曉華則試用反重力跑步機，感受低負重跑步。另有椎間盤突出康復者親身體驗中西協作治療後，腰部痛楚、易倦情況均有改善。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#15粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語和紀封正苦惱為檀嘉銘的樂隊尋覓練習場地，恰巧盧西亞校友聚會想要重溫老上海感覺，紀封巧妙安排樂隊演出，兩全其美。老年校友入住當天，大堂一團亂，懷孕的安經理又被送上救護車，蜜語在她拜託下留在大堂幫忙…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 樓盤新視野 之港島東太古式生活粵
再創世紀#23粵
programme.desc: 明晞發現智健與非原居民關係友好，說服他出面談判。高哲回港，設計阻止啟堂坐回主席之位，啟堂懷恨在心。學禮與敬賢父子關係曝光，令屈奇頓解除學禮顧問一職。啟堂威脅高哲，高哲逼不得已辭職，叮囑定垚不能讓啟堂坐回主席之位。天生贏得大嶼山項目，公司股價急升。一份環評報告出現，指選址不適合興建發電站，季生賬面損失慘重，但天生看似另有謀算。傲堂新樓盤價單流出，嘉菲背黑鍋離職，啟堂安插親信接掌地產部，並架空定垚。

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.title: 東坡家事#25粵PG
programme.desc: 東坡認為皇上應請太后回宮，被皇上下旨重打三十板。東坡向家人宣布決定辭官回鄉，此時聖旨到要擢升東坡。月娥欲以高價頂讓春釀坊；季常勸月娥收手，她反要季常簽署休書。季常等人來到城門，守衛不准他們離開……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#163粵
programme.desc: 不懂下廚的富太朱莉亞，將整個菜檔包下來揀菜。朋好心教授揀菜心得，但富太毫不在意。朋回到廚藝中心，發現該名富太竟是他班上的學生。朋更發現，朱莉亞對廚藝雖極有熱誠，但卻亳無天分，更弄出不少笑話，令朋燒傷。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 楊康被擒關在歸雲莊，他本想騙穆念慈替金人通風報信卻被識破。穆念慈給梅超風留下求救消息後被歐陽克挾持，歐陽克逼梅超風交出《九陰真經》。陸乘風收到骷髏頭，知道歸雲莊有難，此時裘千仞和六怪也來到莊內。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 朱元璋如何由乞丐搖身一變成為明太祖？原來當時目不識丁的他收到一封信，最後令他走上成王之路！陳世美是人所共知的宇宙最強負心男，「歷史大誤解」卻指他為官清廉，而且夫唱婦隨？「衣食住行」直擊古代樓市炒風。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 朱元璋出身寒微，因怕人取笑，遂大興文字獄；他設立錦衣衛對付左右朝政的開國功臣，陶傑、王晶話你知他殺得有理。明朝千億貪官劉瑾，被《亞洲華爾街日報》報道為千年以來最有錢的六個中國人，他現身講述貪官發跡史。

programme.title: 王國戰隊
programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 王國戰隊
programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.desc: After a suicide attempt, 17-year-old Paul is sent to a psychiatric centre by his father. There, he encounters other youths with issues just like him, one of whom is Toni.

programme.title: Sarah Kohr: Ghosts Of The Past
programme.desc: Ex-gang leader Degen escapes prison after 19 years, putting inspector Sarah Kohr and prosecutor Anton Mehringer in danger. Unable to count on the authorities without risking their secrets, they must confront their pasts when Degen kidnaps Anton's son.

programme.title: As For Me
programme.desc: Torn between her unreliable college sweetheart and her steady new admirer from her workplace, follow Kanako as she navigates career dreams, messy relationships, and self-worth—an honest, bittersweet look at growing up and choosing yourself.

programme.title: A Childhood
programme.desc: As summer drags by, 13-year-old Jimmy, forced by circumstance to become an adult too soon, runs up against the limits of his small hometown and his turbulent life, caught between a mother on the slide and a stepfather who keeps her down.

programme.title: Black As The Snow 4: The Devil's Eye
programme.desc: After receiving a mysterious wooden sculpture of a devil with glowing red eyes, Meyer finds himself entangled in a disturbing case. Kat, a mystical-looking sculptor, may hold the key to this case where technology and occult forces intertwine.

programme.title: My Killer Buddy
programme.desc: Denni is 10 years old and has a mission, to save his mother from his father's violence. For this reason he devises an infallible plan: he will have him killed by someone who kills people for a living, a super-killer.

programme.title: Intimate Stranger
programme.desc: In post-COVID Tokyo, single mother Megumi is desperate to find her missing son Shinpei. After a shady young man claims to know her son’s whereabouts, he is invited into Megumi’s home where he soon uncovers a shocking secret.

programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout blast off on a global adventure to Peru, South America, to uncover the stinky secret of a colony of Humboldt penguins living in the desert. Along the way, Andy encounters some boisterous sea lions and tries a bit of crowd surfing.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Smooth Coated Otters
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet off in the Explorer to Singapore on a global adventure to help guide a smooth-coated otter family back to the safety of a nearby river.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggee's infectious laughter, once everyone starts, it's so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiancé and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him…

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people by siding with the Qing and recruiting fighters from all backgrounds. Members of the Wudang and Emei sects are among the first to surrender and collude with local bullies. When they attack the Shaolin Monastery, its renowned disciples must unite to fight their enemies.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of "Robin Hood" meets "The Sting". Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (who's done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, it's the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. It's a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because people's lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, &amp;amp; colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed “The Invincible Fist” is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank &amp; returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.desc: When a distant cousin of the Twins named Gruffnut arrives on Dragon's Edge, Tuffnut tries to impress him, but Gruffnut may not be the hero he seems.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Midnight Scrum
programme.desc: When Viggo puts a bounty on Hiccup's head, every Dragon Hunter in the world is after capturing Hiccup, so Toothless and the Riders must rescue him.

programme.title: Fast &amp; Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Enter SH1FT3R
programme.desc: Tony goes head-to-head with SH1FT3R’s main recruiter Layla Gray in a death-defying spy race through LA Tunnels, parking lots and construction sites. Tony’s awesome driving impresses Shashi Dhar (the head of SH1FT3R and the person Ms. Nowhere wants them to investigate), and after Tony and his crew pull a heist on a big rig full of energy drinks for Shashi, they’re officially accepted into the circuit.

programme.title: Fast &amp; Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ghost Town Grand Prix
programme.desc: Tony races against Shashi and Layla through a Northern California ghost town, but Shashi and Layla are using the race as a cover for a heist on a billionaire’s train. Tony and his team are introduced to the other cool SH1FT3R racers, and while they can’t stop the heist without blowing their cover, they do manage to get a tracker on the train car Shashi and Layla stole.

programme.title: Fast &amp; Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Owl Job
programme.desc: Shashi sends Tony and Layla to steal weapons codes from a Russian oligarch, while Margaret “Echo” Pearl, Cisco and Frostee use Shashi’s absence to sneak into Shashi’s Cliffside mansion to investigate. Ms. Nowhere tells the team to look for the “keys” in Shashi’s mansion, but all they find are a couple of awesome super-cars.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Lost City
programme.desc: With a map from the comic book, Po and Blade make the treacherous journey through the desert to the lost city, and once inside they find the guardian of the fire whip, Rukhmini. The mysterious figure, a stag named Colin, forges an uneasy alliance with Klaus and Veruca.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Last Guardian
programme.desc: In order to earn the fire whip, Po and Blade have to get themselves and Rukhmini out of a lost city with no exits, but Rukhimi’s not exactly who she says she is. Our villains’ alliance shatters when Colin realizes the weasels are mages with magical powers, and he leaves Klaus gravely injured.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - A Thread In The Dark
programme.desc: Klaus is injured and Veruca’s mage powers are not working, stifled by her time in prison. They encounter a dangerous village and Veruca reconnects with her abilities in time to save Klaus, but the two are soon captured by Po and Blade, who are unaware of Veruca’s rekindled powers.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Mudslinging
programme.desc: Jim is nominated for Spring Fling King Meanwhile Strickler brings Angor Rot to Arcadia so the Troll assassin can meet his prey.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Roaming Fees May Apply
programme.desc: Jims quest for Gunmars birthstone sends the gang deep into the heart of a volcano that is not what it seems and Strickler seeks to protect himself.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Roaming Fees May Apply
programme.desc: Jims quest for Gunmars birthstone sends the gang deep into the heart of a volcano that is not what it seems and Strickler seeks to protect himself.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Blinky's Day Out
programme.desc: After the events at Gattos Keep Blinky is transformed into a human being and Jim discovers the assassin that is hunting him.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Moonlight Run
programme.desc: Aja and Krel hitch a ride in Stuart’s old UFO on a mission to rescue Vex from a bounty hunter outpost on the Moon. Meanwhile, Zadra receives intel about Morando from a surprising new ally.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Dogfight Days of Summer
programme.desc: With Morando and his Armada heading for Earth, Aja and Krel clash with Vex and Zadra over how to handle the situation. Vex and Zadra want to alert human authorities, while the Royal teens seek out a more creative solution -- video games.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Mother's Day
programme.desc: The arrival of Tronos – a bounty hunter with the power to control electricity – sparks an investigation by Area 49-B that threatens to expose the Royals’ alien identities. Meanwhile, Mother watches as the Royals struggle to work together to deal with this new threat.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Dragon's Den
programme.desc: The race is on to find the Genesis Seals as Douxie and Archie look for clues in a notorious dragon's lair. Claire searches the shadows for Jim's soul.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Our Final Act
programme.desc: The Arcane Order pushes Douxie to make an impossible choice: save his friends ... or save the planet. Which will he pick? Only time will tell.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Queen Of Police Roidian Prom
programme.desc: When Tip takes over Kyle's job as "King of Police," she removes all rules from Boovsland and it descends into chaos; Tip and Oh accompany DieAnne to Roidian Prom

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Where The Koobish Roam Best Friendiversary
programme.desc: On a Koobish cattle drive together, Tip and Krunkle's differences result in Oh and the herd getting lost in a stampede; Tip and Oh can't agree on how to celebrate their Friendiversary

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Chicken at Sea The Key Master
programme.desc: Archibald hits the high seas to help out endangered turtles. It's Archibald to the rescue when the citizens of Crackridge report a series of thefts.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Best in Show Bot The Secret of Madame Baroness
programme.desc: Archibald hides inside Loy's robot after accidentally breaking it. A lost boomerang leads to a job working for a fancy singer.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Trains Her Cat
programme.desc: When Olivia's class holds a pet talent show, nobody can beat Francine's amazingly talented cat Gwendolyn. Olivia's lethargic cat Edwin, who barely moves, suddenly goes missing. Olivia then fancies herself a cat detective as shetracks down the missing cat.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia's Lemonade Stand
programme.desc: Olivia's lemonade stand is losing customers to Francine's pink lemonade stand. Olivia does her one better by opening up her own full-scale backyard restaurant, imagining it's a fabulous supper club. But Olivia soon finds that her restaurant needs something she can only get from Francine – something pink!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Takes A Road Trip
programme.desc: On the looooong drive to Grandma's house, Olivia finds ways to pass the time. She imagines her family traveling in style, as she pilots her very own jumbo jet–Olivia Air! By the time they arrive at Grandma's, Olivia's had so much fun that the discomfort of the road trip has been forgotten.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Goes International
programme.desc: When asked to give a presentation for her class's International Day. Olivia can't decide which country to choose. Being Olivia she invents her own country –Olivitania -where cupcakes are the national food and the national anthem sounds suspiciously like Puccini.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - A Cat-Tabulous Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas time in the dollhouse! After putting the final topper on the Christmas tree, Figgy the Elf calls and says that Santa Kitty needs help in his workshop, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go help her out. After some toy fixing and boxing fun, Gabby and Pandy get to meet Santa Kitty and his Kitty reindeer and join him delivering presents to all their friends in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Banana Bread Burglar Finding Meow Meow
programme.desc: When the banana bread Harper leaves out for Eden is stolen, the Dew Drops create a sting operation to catch the thief. When Captain Meow Meow gets a splinter in his paw and hears the word "vet," he flees. Now it's up to the Dew Drops to find Captain Meow Meow and get that splinter out.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Catch that Drone The Fairy of the Teeth
programme.desc: When Harper's drone flies away it’s up to the Dew Drops to get it back. And while Eden wishes she could fly like a drone, she learns that she can do great things with or without wings. When Dylan loses his first tooth the Dew Drops learn that the Tooth Fairy will be coming and Athena tries so hard to make a good impression that she almost ruins Dylan's first lost tooth experience.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when there's no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the "Whoopsies!" Song.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Easter Kitty Bunny
programme.desc: It’s Easter-time in the dollhouse! When Gabby unboxes an Easter basket with an orange egg inside, all the Gabby Cats want to know what’s inside, but when CatRat accidentally sends it rolling out of Kitty Fairy’s garden, Gabby and Pandy go on a springtime search through the Dollhouse to find it. Then, when the egg hatches, they meet Eggy, the Easter Kitty Bunny! For our Cat of the Day segment, Baby Box gets crafty.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - The Bear Necessities
programme.desc: When their favorite zoo visitor loses his teddy bear, our gang goes on a wild adventure through New York City to return it to him - and in the process Marty learns that some things in life can't be found in an instruction manual.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Melman at the Movies
programme.desc: Melman finds a lucky flower and is convinced that today will be his Best Day Ever! But when a series of unlucky events threaten to ruin his day, he’s faced with the choice to drown in his sorrows or “take back the day”!

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - She Said, She Said Starfish
programme.desc: When one of Rikki’s plants won't sing, Pixie and Juniper both tell their varying recollections of why the plant is suddenly silent. Kelp, Scallop, and Cruz have always thought that starfish did nothing but laze about; but as they go about their day, the starfish goes through his own routine, completely unbeknownst to everyone else.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Leroy’s Caterpillar Lost Spark
programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper look for the plant they think will cure her. Meanwhile Pixie wonders whether she can be cured at all!

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Old Dog, New Tricks \ Snoozie-Hullabaloozie
programme.desc: Tag chooses to pair up with her Grandpaw for the Barker Family Talent Show, and together, they search for their winning talent. \ Tag is surprised to learn that today is the Pawston Snoozie-a-Hullabaloozie. With everything shut down for the day, Tag and Scooch take the opportunity to play all over town, while trying not to wake up other dogs.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Show Dog, Show \ Keys to Victory
programme.desc: Tag can't wait to show off her car at the car show. But when Cheddar Biscuit wants to come along and pick up her clown friends along the way, Tag is wary that Cheddar Biscuit will steal her thunder. \ The Not Yet Cadets can't wait to watch Sam’s big race. But when Sam loses his car key, he challenges the Not Yet Cadets to race around town to find it.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Little Kisses Snow Day
programme.desc: Tip busts Oh eating kitty litter and says he'll never get kissed by My Mom again.Oh and Tip help out all his friends when they freeze into Boovsicles.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Struck Through The Heart Boov Up And Drive
programme.desc: Oh has an electric spark when he and Tip do the ultimate best friend handshake.Tip can't get Slushious back until she passes a Boovian Driver's Test.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Sitting On Babies Best Frenemies
programme.desc: Things go very wrong when Tip and Oh watch the Gorg babies at a cheese-themed playlandCaptain Smek pretends to be Oh's friend just to ruin his day.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Sacks O' Cash Oh Give Me A Home
programme.desc: Tip and Oh use Slushious as an inter-planetary taxi but Tip takes it too far; Smek becomes homeless and must accept Oh's help.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Dawn Of The Broods Part 1 & Part 2
programme.desc: Grug convinces The Croods to go on vacation, and they find a new family, The Broods, who live in a solitary utopia too good to be trueThe Croods must escape and warn Ahhh! Valley before it's too late.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - It Takes Ahhh Valley Part 1 & 2
programme.desc: When the Croods return to Ahhh! Valley they find that the evil Brood family has taken over and Grug must work with fellow Valleyites to defeat them

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S2 - The Night Pig Twigula
programme.desc: Kensington is terrorized by her overactive imagination when a possum comes into the yard and tangles with the Mighty Ones. Berry mistakenly thinks that Twig is a juice sucker (like vampires for berries) and tries to convince him to make her into one too.

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S2 - Mystery! On the Yard Express Lindsay Joins the Band
programme.desc: While passengers on board a fancy train, the Mighty Ones become a part of a classic whodunit. With an impending visit from Breht’s mother, Lindsay discovers she has more fun with her next door neighbors.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - Ugly Duckling
programme.desc: As Puss readies a team to defend San Lorenzo, he's shocked to discover his mentor El Guante Blanco has taken on the Ugly Ducking as his newest protégé.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S2 - The Muscle
programme.desc: When traveling to recruit the mighty Golem for their mission, Puss tries to prove that no one is better than him at being "the muscle" of the team.

programme.title: Puss in Boots: The Three Diablos S1 - Puss In Boots: The Three Diablos
programme.desc: After Puss in Boots is captured by soldiers he is enlisted to re-steal the priceless “Heart of Fire Ruby” a ruby stolen by the notorious, wicked and impossible-to-hear villain, known as The Whisperer. Puss must partner with the villain's henchmen, The Three Little Kittens, to seize the ruby. Babysitting has never been more dangerous. Will our hero Puss in Boots tame the Three Diablos in time to recover the ruby?

programme.title: Far Far Away Idol S1 - Far Far Away Idol
programme.desc: Watch your favorite Shrek characters sing the night away in this hilarious spoof. Join in the fun as Fiona, Puss in Boots, Donkey and the rest of the Far Far Away Kingdom battle it out in a singer's showdown.

programme.title: Shrek the Halls S1 - Shrek The Halls
programme.desc: Shrek's plans for a cozy family celebration spirals into one truly unforgettable Christmas.

programme.title: Donkey's Caroling Christmas-Tacular S1 - Donkey's Caroling Christmas-Tacular
programme.desc: Deck the halls with Donkey's laughter in this all-new crazy and colorful collection of animated Christmas goodies and hilarious holiday surprises.

programme.title: The Pig Who Cried Werewolf S1 - The Pig Who Cried Werewolf
programme.desc: The Three Pigs live in a house together, but Heimlich gets scared when he sees Wolf move in next door and acting strange.

programme.title: The Ghost of Lord Farquaad S1 - The Ghost Of Lord Farquaad
programme.desc: Shrek, Fiona, and Donkey are on their way to the hotel where Shrek and Fiona will spend their honeymoon when they encounter Lord Farquaad's ghost!

programme.title: Hammy's Boomerang Adventure S1 - Hammy's Boomerang Adventure
programme.desc: RJ the raccoon produces a nature video, which turns out to be an excuse for him and the porcupine children to play pranks on Hammy the squirrel

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - In the Cards
programme.desc: When Jun does a Tarot reading for the team, she interprets its meaning to be that the riders will disband! In an effort to defy this fate, Jun forces the group to stick together at all costs as they search for a dragon that has breached the Rakke Town eel barrier.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Eugene’s Lean Mean Extreme Dream Team
programme.desc: With the dragon riders disbanded, Eugene attempts to start his own Dragon Club.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - 404 Alex Not Found
programme.desc: When Thunder accidentally fries Alex’s tablet, Alex goes off on her own and is captured by Buzzsaw.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Chicago
programme.desc: Boss and family go on Spring Break to visit his grandparents in the big city of Chicago. Boss uses the trip to test his business mettle, by getting in a promotion war at a real big adult company. And when a department store refuses to let Gigi and Tim return an item, they wind up unionizing the entire sales force.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Baby Boss
programme.desc: Mom and Dad are panicking after Gigi noticed Boss isn't growing, so Boss "puts himself under", taking a special formula that will turn him int a regular baby long enough to pass a Doctor's checkup. However, with Boss gone, all the villains from this season see it as the perfect time to strike Baby Corp, leaving Staci to hold the floodgates.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Boom Baby
programme.desc: Looking to trim costs, Boss unknowingly fires Boom Baby, a super-undercover Baby Corp worker who displays to parents how unsafe things are by pratfalling on them and crying for attention. Convinced he's the victim of a conspiracy, Boom leaves a wake of parent worry in his path, forcing Boss to stop him.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Monstrous Mayhem of the Massive Melviathan
programme.desc: A run-of-the-mill arts and crafts session turns into an interdimensional adventure from which Harold, George and company may never return.

programme.desc: Krupp's campers take on rich rivals in a hoity-toity boat race that also features a revenge-obsessed giant salamander. Paging Captain Underpants!

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Arsenal (MW27) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Spurs have lost their last three Premier League home games against Arsenal, as many as they had in their previous 23 (W10 D10). They last lost four in a row against them between 1952 and 1955.

programme.title: Burnley vs Brentford (MW28) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Brentford have won three of their last four league games against Burnley (L1) and are looking to complete the league double over the Clarets for just the second time after 1934-35.

programme.title: Aston Villa vs Chelsea (MW29) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Following their 2-1 victory at Stamford Bridge earlier this season, Aston Villa are looking to complete a league double over Chelsea for the first time since the 1989-90 campaign.

programme.title: Newcastle United vs Sunderland (MW31) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Sunderland are unbeaten in their last 10 league games against Newcastle (W7 D3), winning seven of the last eight. It’s the joint-longest run either side has had without defeat in the history of the fixture (Newcastle also 10 between 1985 and 1997).

programme.title: Manchester City vs Arsenal (MW33) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester City are unbeaten in their last 10 Premier League home games against Arsenal (W7 D3) since a 2-0 loss in January 2015 under Manuel Pellegrini.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Aston Villa (MW30) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost just two of their last 37 home league games against Aston Villa (W28 D7), going down 1-0 both times in December 2009 and September 2021.

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Brighton and Hove Albion (MW33) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Tottenham are winless in their last three Premier League games against Brighton (D1 L2), having previously never gone more than once without a win against the Seagulls in the top-flight.

programme.title: A Bride For A Ride - EP13
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUN

programme.title: Married But Available - EP3
programme.desc: An unexpected event leads couple Ouyang Zicong and Zhu Mingming to decide to get married. However, to avoid offending her boss, Shi Lujia, Mingming has to conceal her marital status. Meanwhile, Zicong is invited by his college classmate Zhang Zhanbo to join Lujia's company, plotting to reclaim the gold business founded by Zhanbo's father, Zhang Jianguo. The secretly married couple are forced into conflict within the company, gradually developing misunderstandings. Furthermore, Zhanbo and Mingmin

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma - EP13
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage.

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary - EP24
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: Always And Ever - EP14
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his ey
